mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_base_deletion_task ( task_id, owner_id, knowledge_base_id, task_type, idempotency_key, input_snapshot, skill_version, status, progress, attempt_count, max_attempts, error_summary, result_ref, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( CAST(#{id} AS uuid), #{ownerId}, CAST(#{knowledgeBaseId} AS uuid), #{taskType}, #{idempotencyKey}, CAST(#{inputSnapshot} AS jsonb), #{skillVersion}, #{status}, #{progress}, #{attemptCount}, #{maxAttempts}, #{errorSummary}, #{resultRef}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT task_id, owner_id, knowledge_base_id, task_type, idempotency_key, input_snapshot::text AS input_snapshot, skill_version, status, progress, attempt_count, max_attempts, error_summary, result_ref, created_at, updated_at, started_at, completed_at FROM knowledge_base_deletion_task WHERE task_id = CAST(#{taskId} AS uuid)

SELECT task_id, owner_id, knowledge_base_id, task_type, idempotency_key, input_snapshot::text AS input_snapshot, skill_version, status, progress, attempt_count, max_attempts, error_summary, result_ref, created_at, updated_at, started_at, completed_at FROM knowledge_base_deletion_task WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_base_deletion_task SET status = #{nextStatus}, attempt_count = #{attemptCount}, error_summary = #{errorSummary}, progress = CASE WHEN #{nextStatus} = 'RUNNING' THEN 50 WHEN #{nextStatus} = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN 100 ELSE progress END, updated_at = NOW(), started_at = CASE WHEN #{nextStatus} = 'RUNNING' THEN NOW() ELSE started_at END, completed_at = CASE WHEN #{nextStatus} IN ('DEAD_LETTER', 'SUCCEEDED') THEN NOW() ELSE completed_at END WHERE task_id = CAST(#{taskId} AS uuid) AND status = #{currentStatus}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_base_deletion_audit ( audit_id, task_id, owner_id, knowledge_base_id, action, task_status, created_at ) VALUES ( CAST(#{id} AS uuid), CAST(#{taskId} AS uuid), #{ownerId}, CAST(#{knowledgeBaseId} AS uuid), #{action}, #{taskStatus}, #{createdAt} )
